'''Tempest Squad''' was a [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] unit active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Officially off-duty, they joined [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] [[Cheketta]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ralon Nys]] in [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|attacking]] the Imperial-held [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Two members of the squad were killed alongside Ralon Nys by an Imperial [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who had infiltrated the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]].
